description: Verify that OfferService instance_id is not reserved (0x0000 / 0xFFFF) in reply to a FindService with instance_id=0xFFFF (SOME/IP §5.1.4)
approach:
[Objective]
A wildcard FindService (instance_id = ANY = 0xFFFF) asks for any matching service. DUT must reply with a concrete instance_id, never the reserved sentinels 0x0000 or 0xFFFF — those would be ambiguous.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: FindService with instance_id = 0xFFFF.
2. Observation: DUT → Tester: OfferService
   • entry instance_id ≠ 0x0000 AND ≠ 0xFFFF   ← key check

[Pass condition]
OfferService entry carries a non-reserved instance_id.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_instance_zero — entry uses reserved 0x0000
• Fail_instance_all — entry uses reserved 0xFFFF
• Fail_timeout — no OfferService within listen window

verdicts.Pass: DUT replied with non-reserved instance_id — normal
